summary: Iteration 4 backend re-test after adding sliding-window _TokenBudget (TPM=5500, RPM=28, 60s window) + _estimate_tokens helper in /app/backend/agents.py, and bumping _llm_call retries from 3 to 5. Extended existing pytest suite (12 tests) with wider deadlines (240s -> 360s) to accommodate the budgeter's proactive pacing. Full suite passed 12/12 in 189.26s (~3:09). Primary test (upload -> SSE brief -> disconnect -> poll to completion) passed: paper reached 'completed', analysis.summary.tldr non-empty, paper_score > 0, gaps >= 1, keywords >= 1, methodology.strengths >= 1, questions >= 1, final_report > 400 chars. SSE replay had ZERO workflow_error events. Second back-to-back run on same paper_id also completed cleanly with no workflow_error. Standard endpoints (/api/root, /api/upload, /api/papers, /api/paper/{id}, DELETE, /api/stats, /api/semantic-search, /api/search, /api/paper/{id}/pin) all pass. The 429 rate-limit fix (budgeter) is verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: _TokenBudget.acquire() sleeps up to 20s per iteration but loops indefinitely if under sustained overload — could add a max total wait to fail-fast rather than hang a workflow silently.

TPM=5500 is hardcoded default; a paper with very long condensed input could push _estimate_tokens above 5500 for a single call and hang forever in the while loop (bug: the check `used_tokens + tokens <= self.tpm` will never be true if tokens alone > tpm). Recommend clamping tokens to min(tokens, self.tpm-100) or raising when tokens > tpm.
agents.py is now ~741 lines and mixes budgeter, retry logic, prompts, agent nodes, and orchestration — worth splitting into agents/ package.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded /tmp/mtech.pdf during test; deleted at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Budgeter validated: full analysis now takes ~3min instead of ~30s (expected trade-off for zero rate-limit errors). Suite deadlines were extended to 6min to accommodate. If TPM_LIMIT / RPM_LIMIT lowered further, deadlines may need another bump. Watch out for the potential infinite-loop edge case in _TokenBudget.acquire() when a single call's estimated_tokens exceeds tpm.
